rules.when: Thinking work: design, planning, an investigation, or a hard bug whose cause is unknown.
Frontend work: web pages, styling, layout, or a web interface component.
Work that needs the Luna model: image generation or reading a very large document set at once.
Bulk mechanical work across many files: renames, codemods, or mass formatting.

beats.when: the change is the same edit repeated

rules.when: Fast work that needs no thinking: a typo, a version bump, or a one-line configuration change.
Well-scoped implementation with a stated plan and acceptance criteria.
Any work on the Example Shop website or the Example Arena game.
